text_en: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood; it was two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
text_cn: 贝匝肋耳用皂荚木做了一个柜，长二肘半，宽一肘半，高一肘半，

text_en: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold around it.
text_cn: 里外包上了纯金，周围做了金花边。

text_en: He cast for it four rings of gold for its four feet, two rings on its one side and two rings on its other side.
text_cn: 铸了四个金环，安在四个脚上：这边两个，那边两个。

text_en: He made poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold,
text_cn: 又用皂荚木做了杠杆，包上了金。

text_en: and put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to carry the ark.
text_cn: 将杠杆穿入柜边的环内，作抬柜之用。

text_en: He made a mercy seat of pure gold; two cubits and a half was its length, and a cubit and a half its width.
text_cn: 又用纯金做了赎罪盖，长二肘半，宽一肘半。

text_en: He made two cherubim of hammered gold; at the two ends of the mercy seat he made them,
text_cn: 又做了一对金革鲁宾，由赎罪盖两端用锤工做成；

text_en: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end; of one piece with the mercy seat he made the cherubim at its two ends.
text_cn: 在这端做了一个革鲁宾，在那端做了一个革鲁宾；赎罪盖两端的革鲁宾与赎罪盖连在一起；

text_en: The cherubim spread out their wings above, overshadowing the mercy seat with their wings. They faced one another; the faces of the cherubim were turned toward the mercy seat.
text_cn: 革鲁宾的翅膀，伸展其上，翅膀遮着赎罪盖；他们的脸彼此相对，面朝赎罪盖。

text_en: He also made the table of acacia wood, two cubits long, one cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.
text_cn: 又用皂荚木做了供桌，长二肘，宽一肘，高一肘半，

text_en: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a molding of gold around it.
text_cn: 包上了纯金，周围做了金花边，

text_en: He made around it a rim a handbreadth wide, and made a molding of gold around the rim.
text_cn: 周围做了一掌宽的框子，框子四周，也做了金花边。

text_en: He cast for it four rings of gold, and fastened the rings to the four corners at its four legs.
text_cn: 又铸了四个金环，将金环安在桌四脚的角上。

text_en: The rings that held the poles used for carrying the table were close to the rim.
text_cn: 环子靠近框子，为穿抬供桌的杠杆。

text_en: He made the poles of acacia wood to carry the table, and overlaid them with gold.
text_cn: 又用皂荚木做了杠杆，包上金，为抬供桌之用。

text_en: And he made the vessels of pure gold that were to be on the table, its plates and dishes for incense, and its bowls and flagons with which to pour drink offerings.
text_cn: 又用纯金做了供桌上的器物：盘、碟、杯和为奠祭用的爵。

text_en: He also made the lampstand of pure gold. The base and the shaft of the lampstand were made of hammered work; its cups, its calyxes, and its petals were of one piece with it.
text_cn: 又用纯金做了灯台：灯台同灯座以及灯干，全用锤工做成；花朵，即花托和花瓣，都由灯台发出。

text_en: There were six branches going out of its sides, three branches of the lampstand out of one side of it and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side of it;
text_cn: 灯台两面发出了六叉：这面三叉，那面三叉。

text_en: three cups shaped like almond blossoms, each with calyx and petals, on one branch, and three cups shaped like almond blossoms, each with calyx and petals, on the other branch—so for the six branches going out of the lampstand.
text_cn: 在一叉上，有像杏花的三朵花，都有花托和花瓣；在另一叉上也有像杏花的三朵花，都有花托和花瓣；由灯台发出的六叉都是一样。

text_en: On the lampstand itself there were four cups shaped like almond blossoms, each with its calyxes and petals.
text_cn: 在灯台的直干上，有像杏花的四个花朵，都有花托和花瓣。

text_en: There was a calyx of one piece with it under the first pair of branches, a calyx of one piece with it under the next pair of branches, and a calyx of one piece with it under the last pair of branches.
text_cn: 由灯干发出的每两叉之下，各有一个花朵；从灯干发出的六个叉都是如此。

text_en: Their calyxes and their branches were of one piece with it, the whole of it one hammered piece of pure gold.
text_cn: 这些花朵和灯叉，都从灯台发出，全是用整块纯金锤成。

text_en: He made its seven lamps and its snuffers and its trays of pure gold.
text_cn: 又做了灯台上的七盏灯，以及纯金的灯剪和碟子。

text_en: He made it and all its utensils of a talent of pure gold.
text_cn: 为做灯台和一切用具，用了一塔冷通纯金。

text_en: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood, one cubit long, and one cubit wide; it was square, and was two cubits high; its horns were of one piece with it.
text_cn: 以后用皂荚木做了香坛，长一肘，宽一肘，方形，高二肘，四角从坛上突出。

text_en: He overlaid it with pure gold, its top, and its sides all around, and its horns; and he made for it a molding of gold all around,
text_cn: 又用纯金包了坛、坛的上面、四壁、周围和四角；坛周围做了金花边。

text_en: and made two golden rings for it under its molding, on two opposite sides of it, to hold the poles with which to carry it.
text_cn: 坛两侧花边下，做了两个金环，两面都有，为穿杠杆抬坛之用。

text_en: And he made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.
text_cn: 又用皂荚木做了杠杆，包上了金。

text_en: He made the holy anointing oil also, and the pure fragrant incense, blended as by the perfumer.
text_cn: 以后又以配制香料的方法，做了为傅礼用的圣油，和为焚香用的纯香料。
